t: Titan sanding sponges are a versatile choice for preparing surfaces. This multi-pack offers a range of 40, 80, and 120 grit abrasive aluminium oxide sponges, suitable for sanding wood, paint, varnish, plaster, and filler. Featuring both flat and angled edges, they effectively reach into corners and intricate details, making them ideal for tasks like preparing cabinetry or restoring skirting boards. The durable, tear-resistant foam construction allows for wet and dry use, reducing dust and ensuring a smooth, professional finish on various materials. Washable and reusable, these sponges offer long-lasting performance for trade professionals and DIYers.
b: Suitable for Sanding Wood, Paint, Varnish, Plaster & Filler
